title: Boundary and Landscape Context
alt: GIS map showing Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve, Bhainsrodgarh core addition, surrounding protected areas, rivers, roads and district context
summary: Shows the public MHTR boundary context, including Bhainsrodgarh Wildlife Sanctuary as a core addition noted in the newer Tiger Conservation Plan.
useFor: Use this first when explaining where MHTR sits in the wider Kota, Bundi, Chittaurgarh and Jhalawar landscape.

title: Terrain and Ridge Relief
alt: Shaded relief terrain map of Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve showing ridges, valleys, water lines and core boundary
summary: Uses DEM-derived shaded relief with metre-based elevation bands and high/low callouts to make the ridge-to-valley structure visible.
useFor: Use this to explain why slopes, valleys and long linear ridges shape habitat, visibility, patrol access and movement, with approximate elevation context.
sources: Mapzen/AWS Terrarium elevation tiles, OpenStreetMap, MHTR TCP

title: Water Systems and Hydrology
alt: Hydrology map of Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve showing rivers, reservoirs, canals, roads, rail and nearby settlements
summary: Highlights Chambal-linked rivers, reservoirs, canals and drainage lines around the reserve, with key public water-body names labelled.
useFor: Use this for dry-season stress, wetland value, riparian corridors and water-linked movement context.
sources: OpenStreetMap, Mapzen/AWS Terrarium elevation tiles, MHTR TCP

title: Elevation Zones and Contours
alt: Elevation-zone GIS map of Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve with DEM-derived bands, contours, waterways and core boundary
summary: Classifies local elevation bands in metres, adds 50 m contours, and marks representative high-ridge and lower-valley points.
useFor: Use this when discussing high ridges, lower valleys, drainage floors and terrain-driven microhabitats with approximate DEM elevation values.
sources: Mapzen/AWS Terrarium elevation tiles, OpenStreetMap, MHTR TCP

title: Land-cover and Habitat Context
alt: ESA WorldCover land-cover map around Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve showing tree cover, grassland, shrubland, cropland, built-up area and water
summary: Uses ESA WorldCover 2021 to show broad tree cover, shrubland, grassland, cropland, built-up area, bare ground and water.
useFor: Use this as a habitat base layer, then interpret fine habitat details with field notes and forest records.
